name: ESCape32 page capability and save semantics
step: Check real page with transport and Ethos form doubles
rationale: Unknown firmware sends no OPEN; only validated targets are shown; edit requires readback; normalization replaces local drafts; Save does not claim persistence; close removes handlers and subscriptions. Verified 17.3 is the main fixture; unknown 17.4/16.3 identities expose no read/edit/apply/save actions.
